# Adapter — Figma → spec-pack

> **Phase 2 packet.** Read [`spec-pack.md`](spec-pack.md) first.

**No adapter yet, not proven.** There is no script and no WordPress build from Figma, so this packet
lists no steps. The path today: export the frames to HTML (or ask the designer to export them), then use
[`from-html.md`](from-html.md), recording in `provenance.json.notes` the original Figma file, the exported nodes and the time.
Do not guess hex values from screenshots, and do not ask the requester for a verbal description and treat it as extraction — a
spec-pack with invented numbers is worse than no spec-pack, because every later phase trusts it. When there is a real build from Figma,
this packet is rewritten from that build.
